title.en: Specialized expertise and dedicated veterinary staff

text.en: Clients frequently commend doctors such as Dr Tom Mullany and Dr William Hayden for their clinical diligence and transparent explanations. Reviewers highlight dedicated nursing care and compassionate support during critical treatments. While one owner felt dismissed during an emergency dispute, most clients report high trust in the veterinary team.

Several reviewers praise life-saving diagnoses and thorough cardiac assessments that returned critically sick pets to health. Conversely, one pet parent described serious post-surgical wound dehiscence and lengthy recovery complications after tumour removal, and another reported fatal poisoning. Medical treatment outcomes vary between cases.

Reviewers emphasize the genuine warmth and patience shown towards sick cats and elderly dogs during complex clinical procedures. Pet parents note that veterinary surgeons and nurses take time to minimize stress and ensure animals remain comfortable throughout extensive diagnostics and prolonged health management.

q.en: Does Nutgrove Veterinary Hospital provide cardiology specialist services?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight advanced veterinary cardiology services, including echocardiograms and ECG testing.

q.en: Are diagnostic findings explained thoroughly to pet owners?

a.en: Yes, reviewers appreciate detailed, step-by-step explanations of ultrasound results and clinical options provided by specialists.

q.en: Are modern surgical facilities available at Nutgrove?

a.en: Yes, the clinic operates fully equipped operating theatres and diagnostic suites in its modern hospital facility.

q.en: How do veterinarians support pets during end-of-life care?

a.en: Owners commend clinicians for their sensitivity, patience, and empathetic support during palliative treatment and difficult final weeks.
